name: hyperliquid_collector-mcp
description: Hyperliquid REST (market data): me, search_symbols. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public info endpoint, no credentials: the probe posts {"type": "meta"} (weight 20).

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Perpetuals universe from {"type": "meta"}: every listed coin (name, szDecimals, maxLeverage, isDelisted in `raw`) in one response; there is no text filter or pagination, so `query`, `page` and `limit` are ignored (filter client-side). Spot pairs (spotMeta) are not mapped.
